system.description:
Fate Changer: re-roll a Skill Check with +1 Talent Die in your Dice Pool. Each use moves the Doom Clock forward 5 minutes. Limited to 5 uses.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.158
system.summary: Fate Changer: re-roll a Skill Check with +1 Talent Die in your Dice Pool. Each use moves the Doom Clock forward 5 minutes. Limited to 5 uses.

when.label: Fate Changer: re-rolling with the Monkey's Paw

automation.note: After a Skill Check, click Use (spends 1 of 5 uses and adds 5 minutes to the Doom Clock), then roll the check again with the Fate Changer bonus ticked.
